sanskrit: imaṃ me kuṣṭha pūruṣaṃ tam ā vaha taṃ niṣ kṛdhi | tam u me agadaṃ kṛdhi ||
english: O kuṣṭha plant, bring this man of mine back to me, draw him forth; make him free of disease for me.

sanskrit: udaṅ jāto himavataḥ sa prācyāṃ nīyase janam | tatra kuṣṭhasya nāmāny uttamāni vi bhejire ||
english: Born in the north from the Himālaya, thou art conveyed to the people of the east; there the most excellent names of kuṣṭha have been distributed abroad.

sanskrit: uttamo nāmāsy uttamo nāma te pitā | yataḥ kuṣṭha prajāyase tata ehy ariṣṭatātaye ||
english: Uttama ('the highest') is thy name, Uttama is the name of thy father; from whence thou art born, O kuṣṭha, from thence come hither for the sake of unimpaired well-being.

sanskrit: śīrṣahatyām upahatyām akṣyos tanvo rapaḥ | kuṣṭho no viśvatas pātu daivaṃ samaha vṛṣṇyam ||
english: The shattering of the head, the stroke upon the body, the blemish of the eyes — may kuṣṭha protect us on all sides, and together establish divine virile strength.

sanskrit: yad agnir āpo adahat praviśya yatrākṛṇvan dharmadhṛto namāṃsi | tatra ta āhuḥ paramaṃ janitraṃ sa naḥ saṃvidvān pari vṛṅdhi takman ||
english: Where Agni, having entered the waters, burned them, where the upholders of sacred ordinance performed their obeisances — there, they say, is thy highest birthplace; O takman, knowing us, ward us about and spare us.

sanskrit: yadi śoko yady abhīśoko rudrasya prāṇo yadi vāruṇo 'si | huḍur nāmāsi haritasya deva sa naḥ saṃvidvān pari vṛṅdhi takman ||
english: Whether thou art grief, or intense burning grief, or the breath of Rudra, or art of Varuṇa's nature — Huḍu is thy name, O god of the yellow one; O takman, knowing us, ward us about and spare us.

sanskrit: yady arcir yadi vāsi dhūmaḥ śakalyeṣu yadi vā te janitram | huḍur nāmāsi haritasya deva sa naḥ saṃvidvān pari vṛṅdhi takman ||
english: Whether thou art flame, or whether thou art smoke, or whether thy origin be among the śakalyas — Huḍu is thy name, O god of the yellow one; O takman, knowing us, ward us about and spare us.

sanskrit: namaḥ śītāya takmane namo rūrāya kṛṇmo vayaṃ te | yo +'nyedyur ubhayadyuś caranti tṛtīyakāya namo astu takmane ||
english: Homage to the cold takman, homage to the burning one — thus we make obeisance to thee; to him who comes on alternate days, on both days, let there be homage to the tertian takman.

sanskrit: tṛtīyakaṃ vitṛtīyaṃ sadandim uta hāyanam | takmānaṃ viśvaśāradaṃ graiṣmaṃ nāśaya vārṣikam ||
english: The tertian, the non-tertian, the quotidian, and likewise the annual — the all-autumnal takman, the summer fever and the rainy-season fever — destroy them all.

sanskrit: āpo adyānv acāriṣaṃ rasena sam asṛkṣmahi | payasvān agna āgamaṃ taṃ mā saṃ sṛja varcasā ||
english: Today I have moved along with the waters; we have mingled together with their sap. O Agni, full of milk I have come; unite me with that radiant energy.

sanskrit: saṃ māgne varcasā sṛja prajayā ca bahuṃ kṛdhi | vidyur me asya devā indro vidyāt saha rṣībhiḥ ||
english: O Agni, unite me with radiant energy and make me abundant with offspring; may the gods take note of this for me, may Indra know it together with the seers.

sanskrit: idam āpaḥ pra vahata- -avadyaṃ ca malaṃ ca yat | yac ca dudrohānṛtaṃ yac ca śepe abhīruṇam ||
english: O waters, carry away from here whatever blame and impurity there may be, whatever untruth one has committed in deceit, and whatever shameful thing one has uttered in a curse.

sanskrit: śivena mā cakṣuṣā paśyatāpaḥ śivayā tanvopa spṛśata tvacaṃ me | śivān agnīn apsuṣado havāmahe mayi kṣatraṃ varca ā dhatta devīḥ ||
english: O waters, look upon me with a benevolent eye; touch my skin with your benevolent body. We invoke the auspicious fires that dwell in the waters; O goddesses, bestow sovereignty and radiance upon me.

sanskrit: yad āpo naktaṃ mithunaṃ cacāra yad vā dudroha duritaṃ purāṇam | hiraṇyavarṇās tata ut punantu mā pra mā muñcantu varuṇasya pāśāt ||
english: Whatever illicit union one may have committed in the night, or whatever ancient sin of treachery — may the golden-hued waters purify me therefrom; let them release me, let them free me from the noose of Varuṇa.
